messages:
mira: noticed a slow uptick in pending small GPU pods in europe-west2; looks like many 0.5s scattered while a few nodes hold contiguous 4/8 slots reserved by anchors

cory: can you paste a pending pod and node snapshot?

mira: pending pod:
```
Name: infer-small-113
requests: nvidia.com/gpu: 0.5
annotations: redwood/scheduler-anchor: "family-x"
Status: Pending (0/72 nodes fit: Insufficient contiguous gpus)
```

mira: node snapshot (sanitized):
```
node-a: 8 free contiguous (anchor=family-y)
node-b: 4 free contiguous (anchor=family-z)
node-c: 0.5s spread across many hosts
```

jess: infra-bot showed fragmentation alert earlier:
infra-bot: [alert] fragmentation_high europe-west2 unusable_gpus=36 anomaly=0.69

cory: last week's affinity tweak increased family-anchor weight; anchors are being held too long. root cause likely anchor TTL default=6h from rollout r2026-03-anchor-ttl

jess: mitigation options: 1) revoke stale anchors for noncritical families 2) lower anchor TTL to 10m for noncritical 3) run selective defrag for 0.5 requests only

mira: i can run a cautious defrag dry-run: `infractl defrag --region europe-west2 --filter "requests.gpu==0.5" --dry-run`

ops: approved manual revoke for 4 stale anchors on node-a/b. also approved dry-run.

mira: dry-run indicates ~18 pods would coalesce and free two 4-GPU slots; ready to execute with safety limits (dont-evict-age<5m, max-evict=15%)

cory: please execute now, then lower anchor TTL for noncritical families and open INFRA-8850 to add TTL guardrails + precommit fragmentation checks

infra-bot: [note] defrag_job df-1160 executed; 16 pods moved; freed 2x4 slots; two 4-GPU jobs scheduled; pending decreased by ~22%

jess: i'll add TTL guard and a scheduler unit test to simulate nvlink/anchor + fragment minimizer interactions so future rollouts surface this in canary

mira: updating INFRA-8850 with actions and closing thread unless regressions seen. :white_check_mark:
